About.title: About MindTrack Balance
About.content:
MindTrack Balance is a digital wellbeing platform designed to help you build healthier habits with technology. Our mission is to empower individuals to reclaim their time and attention in an increasingly distracting world.

We believe that technology should serve you, not control you. By providing tools for emotion tracking, mindful pauses, and attention management, we help you find the sweet spot between productivity and peace of mind.

Our team consists of developers, designers, and psychology enthusiasts who are passionate about humane technology.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.content:
Your privacy is our highest priority at MindTrack Balance.

1. Data Collection
We only collect data that is strictly necessary to provide you with insights into your digital habits. This includes the domains you visit and the time spent on them, but only if you explicitly choose to track them.

2. Data Security
Your emotional reflections and browsing data are securely encrypted. We do not sell your personal data to third parties, advertisers, or data brokers.

3. Your Control
You have complete control over your data. You can export or delete your account and all associated data at any time from your settings page.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.content:
Welcome to MindTrack Balance.

1. Acceptance of Terms
By creating an account and using our services, you agree to comply with these terms.

2. Use of Service
You agree to use the service only for personal wellbeing and productivity. You must not abuse the API or attempt to circumvent the extension's limitations in malicious ways.

3. Limitation of Liability
MindTrack Balance is provided 'as is'. We are not responsible for any direct or indirect consequences resulting from your use of the application, including missed deadlines or emotional distress.

4. Changes to Terms
We reserve the right to modify these terms. Continued use of the platform indicates acceptance of any new terms.

Features.heroSubtitle: Everything you need to regain control of your time, understand your emotions, and work more productively.
Features.f1_desc: Regularly log your mood, stress, and energy levels to understand how your digital habits affect your well-being.
Features.f2_desc: A 5-second delay before opening distracting sites. Gives you a chance to ask: "Do I really want to go here?" and stops mindless scrolling.
Features.f3_desc: Set daily limits on specific sites (e.g., 30 mins on YouTube). When the time is up, the site is strictly blocked.
Features.f4_desc: Smart analysis of your patterns (e.g., "You often lose focus on Friday evenings, try taking a break").
Features.f5_desc: Trend charts showing how your anxiety, calm, and productivity levels change throughout the week.
Features.f6_desc: A safe space for check-ins, sharing insights, and support among people who also seek digital detox.
